title: Professional Services Projects Acceptance and Warranty
content:
For Professional Services Projects, when delivery is complete the project manager requests acceptance against the statement of work's acceptance criteria.

## Acceptance window

The client must sign acceptance, or sign a rejection listing defects against those criteria, within the class acceptance window in business days after the request. Silence past that window is deemed acceptance on the day after the window closes.

| Within the window the client... | Result |
|---|---|
| signs acceptance | the project is accepted |
| signs a rejection listing defects against the acceptance criteria | the project returns to remediation |
| signs neither | acceptance is deemed on the day after the window closes |

## Rejections

A rejection returns the project to remediation. After the class's number of documented rejections, the dispute goes to the delivery director instead of another remediation cycle.

## Warranty and closing

Acceptance starts a warranty of the class warranty period in calendar days, during which defects against the statement of work are fixed at no charge; new requirements are change orders. The engagement closes the day after the last day of the warranty.

## Points of judgement

- **Is a defect against the statement of work reported during the warranty charged?** No; it is fixed at no charge.
- **Is a new requirement raised during the warranty a defect?** No; new requirements are change orders.

Hypothetical illustration: with a window of 5 business days and no signed acceptance or rejection, acceptance is deemed on the day after the fifth business day following the request.
